purpose: Machine-readable continuity map from requested URL intake through catalog registration, source/PDF acquisition, loader evidence, parser/conversion, chunking, graph-readiness review, and the fail-closed graph import boundary.

scope_boundary.notes: This map records existing continuity evidence and breakpoints. It does not register missing refs, acquire sources, parse/chunk new inputs, approve graph readiness, write LadybugDB, or attempt production import.

source_artifacts.role: Bounded requested URL intake contract for M030 audit scope.
Prior universal loader evidence summary and typed upstream failure-mode source.
Current pipeline baseline evidence for conversion, chunk counts, import contract, and fail-closed graph status.
End-to-end boundary replay evidence for loader, parser, page index, chunking, evidence, and graph import boundary metrics.
Owner module and verifier inventory used to anchor continuity edges.
Readiness and claim-state source for each pipeline stage.

m027_pipeline_baseline.evidence_status: Existing baseline includes metadata-only and converted variants; converted variants produce retrieval-only chunks but no import-eligible graph packages.

m027_end_to_end_replay.evidence_status: Replay records per-boundary loader, parser, page_index, chunking, evidence, and import_contract metrics while preserving fail-closed graph import status.

stages.label: URL intake
outputs: Bounded selection JSON with normalized identities, reachability metadata, catalog status, prior-selection status, and fail-closed unsafe_claims
observable_surface: Selection counts for requested refs, cataloged refs, missing refs, and prior-selection overlap
Per-ref unsafe_claims that must remain false until downstream replay evidence exists

stages.label: Article catalog registration
inputs: Bounded selection refs from URL intake
Existing article catalog schema and index
outputs: Metadata-only catalog records and index rows
Catalog linkage for later acquisition and replay

stages.label: Source and PDF acquisition
inputs: Selection refs marked ready for acquisition replay
outputs: Local source HTML/PDF artifacts under article_catalog source directories
Source acquisition events and summary diagnostics
observable_surface: Per-variant acquisition events with normalized identity and safe artifact path
Typed diagnostics for missing linkage, identity drift, source-kind drift, and unsafe paths

stages.label: Loader evidence bridge
inputs: Local source artifacts produced or referenced by acquisition
outputs: Loader result classification
Evidence paths for downstream parser/chunk package validation

stages.label: Parser and conversion boundary
inputs: Source role and parser readiness classification
outputs: Converted text artifacts with byte size and sha256 when parser-ready
metadata_only/not_parser_ready payloads when parser is not safe to run
observable_surface: Fail-closed metadata_only reason for non-parser-ready variants

stages.label: Chunking and evidence packaging
outputs: Retrieval-only chunks and package metrics
Counts by chunk type, route, state, refusal, and source span coverage

stages.label: Graph-readiness review
inputs: Chunk packages and import contract metrics
Independent reviewer packet or review events
outputs: Graph readiness review decisions and validation events
Completed-review requirement before import eligibility can be claimed
observable_surface: Explicit refusal to claim trusted KG readiness without review evidence

stages.label: Graph import boundary
inputs: Import contract metrics from chunk package
outputs: Import boundary rehearsal diagnostics
Fail-closed import_ready=false state unless all contract and review gates pass
Catalog records and index rows for requested normalized identities
Registration-ready metadata-only gap list
failure_modes: Malformed or stale selection JSON blocks downstream use before output promotion.
Catalog status drift causes already_cataloged/missing_from_article_catalog decisions to be unsafe.
Duplicate normalized identity or URL variant can split lineage unless grouped before registration.
Missing metadata-only registration for stanford:cs224n:gradient-notes and arxiv:2605.29548 blocks acquisition replay.

outputs: Local source HTML/PDF artifacts
Acquisition events JSONL and summary
failure_modes: Missing catalog row means there is no safe article_ref/variant boundary for source acquisition.
Source-kind drift or identity drift between catalog and acquisition events invalidates lineage.
Unsafe artifact paths must fail before filesystem write or promotion.
Network or fixture acquisition failures must remain typed per-ref diagnostics, not silent partial success.

outputs: Loader status/classification
Evidence path count and evidence bridge records
failure_modes: Missing, malformed, stale-count, duplicate, or missing-linkage acquisition JSONL raises stable input errors or typed diagnostics.
Arxiv abs refs without local PDF artifacts surface upstream_pdf_arxiv_abs_no_local_pdf_artifact.
Optional metadata gaps are observable as upstream_metadata_optional_metadata_missing and must not become parser-readiness claims.
Filesystem output creation/write failures bubble as filesystem exceptions.

inputs: Source role and parser readiness flag
outputs: Converted text artifact with sha256 and byte_size
metadata_only payload with not_parser_ready reason
failure_modes: Metadata-only/not_parser_ready variants must not enter conversion or claim converted text.
Conversion artifact without verified sha256/byte size is not a stable parser boundary output.
Parser fallback may produce retrieval-only evidence but does not imply graph import eligibility.
Raw text or binary payloads must not be embedded into metadata-only outputs.

outputs: Chunk package metrics
Retrieval-only chunks and refusal metrics
failure_modes: Parser-ready variant with zero chunks must be explicitly flagged instead of treated as success.
Evidence path count of zero for parser-ready content breaks downstream traceability.
Retrieval-only chunk state must remain distinct from graph import eligibility.
Source span coverage below contract expectations should block readiness promotion.

inputs: Evidence paths and source span coverage
outputs: Graph readiness export
Independent review decision events
failure_modes: Missing independent review prevents trusted_kg_import_allowed=true.
Retrieval-only chunks without import-eligible state must be refused for graph readiness.
Incomplete evidence paths or source coverage make review non-actionable.
Review event absence must be observable as a blocked/future-scope state, not silently bypassed.

inputs: Import contract metrics with import_ready and import_eligible_chunk_count
outputs: Import boundary rehearsal result
Explicit no-write state when contract/review gates are not satisfied
failure_modes: import_ready=false, has_import_eligible_chunks=false, or import_eligible_chunk_count=0 blocks graph import.
trusted_kg_import_allowed=false must keep graph_import_allowed=false.
production_import_attempted and ladybugdb_written must remain false unless all gates pass.
Any write-capable boundary must fail closed rather than attempting LadybugDB writes from retrieval-only chunks.
